summary: fix(email): render only fallback strings as EJS
description:
Because:
- Subject, action and preview strings were passed to EJS whenever they
  contained `<%`, including localized Fluent values

This commit:
- Returns Fluent values as-is and runs EJS only on the template's
  English fallback, in both email renderers
- Leaves email output unchanged: no Fluent string in this repo or
  fxa-content-server-l10n contains EJS syntax
- Adds tests in both renderers that a Fluent value with an EJS-like
  variable stays literal

Fixes FXA-14604
